Items: blueberry muffin (~100g, ~380 kcal), latte/flat white in a mug (~300ml with milk, ~150 kcal), two slices toast with avocado (~2 slices bread 160-200 kcal plus ~half avocado 80g ~130 kcal, maybe butter) ~350 kcal, and an Equal sweetener packet (~0 kcal).

Served total is roughly 880 kcal. I'll assume about 10% is left over, around 90 kcal, so eaten is about 790 kcal.

Macros eaten: protein ≈ 6 + 8 + 10 = 24 g, minus a little for leftovers → 22 g. Carbs ≈ 50 + 12 + 35 = 97 g → 88 g. Fat ≈ 18 + 7 + 14 = 39 g → 36 g.

Check: 22×4 + 88×4 + 36×9 = 88 + 352 + 324 = 764 kcal, close enough to the 790 estimate.
